trained_on: vendor_risk_train.csv (2,799 rows -- the 70% train split, stratified by true risk band)
validated_on: vendor_risk_validation.csv (600 rows, held out during training)
tested_on: vendor_risk_test.csv (601 rows, touched only for this one final evaluation)
note: Earlier versions of this file were trained on train_model()'s internal ad hoc 80/20 split of the full 4,000-row pool. This version uses a proper stratified train/validation/test split (see generate_train_val_test() in app/model.py) so the reported metrics in results/validation_report.json are an honest, held-out evaluation rather than a single train/test number. The live service's mlflow_utils.train_and_register() still calls train_model() unchanged -- this export is the more rigorously evaluated offline artifact, not a change to what the deployed system trains on.
